notes.general_comments: General comments The majority of candidates demonstrated good knowledge across the whole syllabus. They showed their working clearly and were accurate in their handling of algebra and calculus. They also showed understanding of transformations. There was no evidence that candidates were short of time. Comments on specific questions (a) Most candidates realised that the first transformation to be applied is the second to be written.
